campaign.title: Map and reduce the remaining M2 frequency region

conductor_policy.monitoring: Conductor checks every exponent conversion, weight hypothesis, transform error, endpoint, and source range.
conductor_policy.round_close: Close with an exact covered-region union and one smallest unresolved kernel. A no-go theorem is acceptable.

numerical_purpose: suggest an exact transition for proof
resource_policy.numerical_prohibition: Plots and finite sums cannot promote an asymptotic region.
resource_policy.literature_policy: Audit primary statements for every exponent-pair or double-sum input.

accepted_bounds: K=XL/D^2, LK=XL^2/D^2 in the formal B-process
frozen_target.candidate_dual_target: sum_{h~L}sum_{k~K} a(h,k)e(sqrt(Xhk)) << (LK)^(3/4)X^epsilon for the actual symbol.
forbidden_conflations: known record exponent and conjectural 1/4 target
formal and fully justified Poisson transforms
smooth coefficients and irregular product-grouped divisor coefficients

tasks.target: Independently normalize every accepted block estimate in (delta,ell), prove its exact target-coverage region, include all secondary terms and edge cases, and state the exact uncovered set. Derive the correct abstract exponent-pair inequality but do not import any pair without a primary-source certificate.

Derive the smooth Poisson/B-process formula for a lower/intermediate block far enough to validate or correct K=XL/D^2 and its amplitude. Determine whether a bilinear (LK)^(3/4) product-phase bound is provable by elementary Cauchy/differencing or an audited primary theorem, or show precisely why it is equivalent to a hard divisor-weighted square-root sum. Track zero modes, nonstationary tails, support edges, and coefficient variation.

Attack improvements of T2S below the top edge. Rewrite the shifted block through its near-integer n=d(4m-rho) geometry, test whether the rho=1,3 difference or nonnegative fixed dyadic weights cancel the D/L proximity mass, and construct coherent subfamilies or exact identities. Use bounded computation only to falsify a precise transition or formulate a lemma, with reproducible artifacts.

completion_criteria: Every accepted estimate has a checked region inequality.
The union of proved regions and its complement are explicit.
The formal dual target is validated, corrected, or rejected with full scope.
The two-shift corridor has a mechanism or obstruction.
No global or final theorem is promoted from partial coverage.
campaign.promotion_policy: Round 5 may promote scoped region lemmas, a complete transform, or a no-go obstruction. It may promote M9-M2 only if the entire parameter triangle is rigorously covered, including the endpoint.
